concepts.def: Decline of manufacturing share; UK manufacturing dropped from 35% of GDP (1970) to 10% (2020); Rust Belt and Northern UK.
Population fell from 1.85m (1950) to 640,000 (2020); car industry collapse, suburbanisation, racial tensions, 2013 bankruptcy.
London 2012 regenerated Stratford with athletes' village (East Village), Westfield, Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park.
Tim Smit's biome attraction in former clay pit (2001); 1 million annual visitors; symbol of regenerated post-industrial Cornwall.
Government areas with tax reliefs and simplified planning; Tees Valley EZ aims to attract green tech investment.
European City of Culture spurred 6.5 billion regeneration around Albert Dock and Liverpool One; 9.7m visitor uplift.
